parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Upper Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the refrigerator, typically covering the freezer compartment, made of steel with insulation inside.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the freezer section and seals tightly to maintain low temperature inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges on one side, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Lower Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the refrigerator, covering the main cooling compartment, made of steel with internal insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the main refrigerator section and ensures proper sealing to maintain cooling efficiency.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges on one side, allowing it to open and close easily.
